annotations.title: Fetch a gene's region from a genome

description: Find a gene in an assembly by symbol or locus tag and return its sequence with however much flanking DNA you ask for — the step before designing a knockout, a C-terminal tag or an HDR donor, where you know the gene's name but not its coordinates. Give the assembly accession (GCF_000005845.2 for E. coli K-12 MG1655) and the gene (araC, or the locus tag b0064). `upstream` is upstream OF THE GENE: on a minus-strand gene that is the higher genomic coordinate, and the sequence comes back 5'→3' along the gene either way. Only an EXACT symbol or locus-tag match is used — NCBI's text search is fuzzy and ranks unrelated genes first, so a loose match is reported as a refusal naming what it found rather than answered with the wrong locus.

assembly.description: Assembly accession, with its version — e.g. GCF_000005845.2. GCF_ (RefSeq) carries annotation more often than GCA_.

downstream.description: Bases to include after the gene's 3' end.

format.description: GenBank brings the annotation that falls inside the region; FASTA is sequence only.

gene.description: Gene symbol or locus tag, matched exactly and case-insensitively (araC, b0064).

upstream.description: Bases to include before the gene's 5' end (its promoter side).

name: genome_region
title: Fetch a gene's region from a genome
